verdict.rationale: A training opt-out is a fair question for a hosted platform that captures customer AI-call data such as prompts and tokens, but the evidence pack never documents a policy or setting that excludes customer data from AI model training. Self-hosting, bring-your-own-key encryption middleware and SOC 2 compliance are related data-control features, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
